cases.name: /team-init creates the workbook and the tests, and never the team folder (D35)
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh alpha >/dev/null; printf 'status=%s dec=%s tests=%s team=%s' "$([ -f $w/workbooks/alpha/STATUS.md ] && echo yes)" "$([ -f $w/workbooks/alpha/decisions/DEC-0001-creation.md ] && echo yes)" "$([ -d $w/tests/alpha ] && echo yes)" "$([ -e $w/teams/alpha ] && echo created || echo absent)"

cases.name: the STATUS.md it writes is in phase need, before gate 1, iteration 0, and names /team-need with the slug
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh mail-triage >/dev/null; s=$w/workbooks/mail-triage/STATUS.md; printf '%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s' "$(sed -n 's/^phase: //p' $s)" "$(sed -n 's/^gate_passed: //p' $s)" "$(sed -n 's/^track: //p' $s)" "$(sed -n 's/^iteration: //p' $s)" "$(sed -n 's/^next_action: //p' $s)" "$(sed -n 's/^# //p' $s)"

cases.name: its front matter carries the nine keys of the template, in order, and no placeholder is left
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh alpha >/dev/null; s=$w/workbooks/alpha/STATUS.md; k() { awk 'NR==1{next} /^---/{exit} {sub(/:.*/,""); printf "%s ", $0}' "$1"; }; [ "$(k $s)" = "$(k {{CLAUDE}}/templates/STATUS.md)" ] && printf 'keys=same ' || printf 'bad:keys '; grep -q '{{' $s $w/workbooks/alpha/decisions/DEC-0001-creation.md && printf 'bad:placeholder' || printf 'placeholders=0'

cases.name: its journal opens with the frozen line of /team-init, dated
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh alpha >/dev/null; grep -cE '^- [0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2} — /team-init — workbook and tests created \(DEC-0001\)$' $w/workbooks/alpha/STATUS.md | sed 's/^/journal=/'

cases.name: updated_at carries an offset
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh alpha >/dev/null; sed -n 's/^updated_at: //p' $w/workbooks/alpha/STATUS.md | grep -cE '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}([+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}|Z)$' | sed 's/^/offset=/'

cases.name: DEC-0001 keeps the title line, the three fields and the headings of the decision template, and is accepted
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh alpha >/dev/null; d=$w/workbooks/alpha/decisions/DEC-0001-creation.md; diff <(grep '^## ' {{CLAUDE}}/templates/DECISION.md) <(grep '^## ' $d) >/dev/null && printf 'headings=same ' || printf 'bad:headings '; printf 'title=%s fields=%s status=%s' "$(grep -c '^# DEC-0001 — Creation of the team alpha$' $d)" "$(grep -cE '^- (Date|Requested by|Phase): .+' $d)" "$(tail -n 1 $d)"

cases.name: orkeon-bench status reads the new workbook without a warning, before the team folder exists
cases.cmd: command -v orkeon-bench >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf 'ok (skipped: orkeon-bench is not on the PATH)'; exit 0; }; w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh alpha >/dev/null && (cd $w && orkeon-bench status alpha --json) | jq -e '.phase == "need" and .gate_passed == null and .track == "full" and .iteration == 0 and .next_action == "/team-need alpha" and (.log | length) == 1 and (.warnings | length) == 0' >/dev/null && printf 'ok' || { printf 'MISMATCH'; exit 1; }

cases.name: --light records the light track (D37)
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh --light alpha >/dev/null; sed -n 's/^track: /track=/p' $w/workbooks/alpha/STATUS.md; grep -c 'on the light track' $w/workbooks/alpha/decisions/DEC-0001-creation.md | sed 's/^/dec=/'

cases.name: --adopt keeps the prototype as it is, says so in the journal and in DEC-0001 (D34)
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; mkdir -p $w/teams/proto/crew && echo 'name: proto' > $w/teams/proto/crew/config.yaml; before=$(find $w/teams -type f | sort | xargs cat | cksum); bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh --adopt proto >/dev/null; rc=$?; after=$(find $w/teams -type f | sort | xargs cat | cksum); printf 'rc=%s team=%s journal=%s dec=%s lines=%s' "$rc" "$([ "$before" = "$after" ] && echo untouched || echo changed)" "$(grep -c -- '— /team-init — prototype teams/proto/ adopted' $w/workbooks/proto/STATUS.md)" "$(grep -c 'adopting the prototype' $w/workbooks/proto/decisions/DEC-0001-creation.md)" "$(grep -c '^- ' $w/workbooks/proto/STATUS.md)"

cases.name: a slug already in the method is refused, and nothing is overwritten
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh alpha >/dev/null; echo '- marker' >> $w/workbooks/alpha/STATUS.md; m=$(bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh --light alpha 2>&1 >/dev/null); printf '%s rc=%s kept=%s track=%s' "$m" "$?" "$(grep -c '^- marker$' $w/workbooks/alpha/STATUS.md)" "$(sed -n 's/^track: //p' $w/workbooks/alpha/STATUS.md)"

expect.stdout: is already in the method. /team-status alpha says where it stands. rc=1 kept=1 track=full

cases.name: a team folder that exists is refused without --adopt, which the message names
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; mkdir -p $w/teams/proto/crew; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh proto 2>&1; printf ' rc=%s workbook=%s tests=%s' "$?" "$([ -e $w/workbooks/proto ] && echo created || echo absent)" "$([ -e $w/tests/proto ] && echo created || echo absent)"

cases.name: the refusal of an existing team folder names /team-init --adopt
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; mkdir -p $w/teams/proto/crew; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh proto 2>&1

expect.stdout: a prototype enters the method with `/team-init --adopt proto`

cases.name: --adopt without a crew to adopt is refused
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh --adopt ghost 2>&1; printf ' rc=%s workbook=%s' "$?" "$([ -e $w/workbooks/ghost ] && echo created || echo absent)"

cases.name: a workbook folder that holds files without a STATUS.md is not overwritten
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; mkdir -p $w/workbooks/alpha && echo draft > $w/workbooks/alpha/NEED.md; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh alpha 2>&1; printf ' rc=%s need=%s status=%s' "$?" "$(cat $w/workbooks/alpha/NEED.md)" "$([ -e $w/workbooks/alpha/STATUS.md ] && echo created || echo absent)"

cases.name: a slug that is not kebab-case ASCII is a usage error
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; for s in Mail_Triage -x 'a b' ../x; do bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh "$s" >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '%s ' "$?"; done; printf 'made=%s' "$(ls $w/workbooks 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

cases.name: no slug, two slugs or an unknown option is a usage error
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; a=$?; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh a b >/dev/null 2>&1; b=$?; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh --force a >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '%s %s %s' "$a" "$b" "$?"

cases.name: a folder that is not a workshop is refused: no teams/ and no .claude/
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/nows-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w; m=$(ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh alpha 2>&1); printf '%s rc=%s made=%s' "$m" "$?" "$(ls -A $w | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

expect.stdout: is not a workshop (no teams/ and no .claude/ there). Run it from the workshop, or set ORKEON_WORKSHOP. rc=2 made=0

cases.name: the first approval the new team can receive is gate 1, once its NEED.md exists and the step has submitted it
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh alpha >/dev/null; p='{"hook_event_name":"UserPromptSubmit","session_id":"{{SID}}","prompt":"/team-approve need"}'; a=$(printf '%s' "$p" | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/team-approve.sh | jq -r '.decision'); printf '# Alpha — Need\n' > $w/workbooks/alpha/NEED.md; m=$(printf '%s' "$p" | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/team-approve.sh | jq -r '.decision'); sed -i 's|^next_action: .*|next_action: /team-approve need alpha|' $w/workbooks/alpha/STATUS.md; b=$(printf '%s' "$p" | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/team-approve.sh | jq -r '.systemMessage'); printf 'before=%s written=%s submitted=%s' "$a" "$m" "$b"

expect.stdout: before=block written=block submitted=team-approve: gate 1 (need) recorded for alpha — next: /team-test-plan alpha

cases.name: an empty tests folder is kept by a .gitkeep; one that already holds files is kept as it is, and the script says so
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh alpha >/dev/null; mkdir -p $w/tests/beta && echo x > $w/tests/beta/old.scenario.json; m=$(bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh beta | grep -c 'tests/beta/ — already there with files, kept as they are'); printf 'gitkeep=%s said=%s kept=%s extra=%s' "$([ -f $w/tests/alpha/.gitkeep ] && echo yes)" "$m" "$(cat $w/tests/beta/old.scenario.json)" "$([ -e $w/tests/beta/.gitkeep ] && echo yes || echo no)"

cases.name: a failure half-way leaves nothing behind: the workbook just created is removed when the tests folder cannot be
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; : > $w/tests; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; m=$(bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh alpha 2>&1); printf '%s rc=%s workbook=%s' "$m" "$?" "$([ -e $w/workbooks/alpha ] && echo left || echo gone)"

cases.name: after such a failure the workbook is gone and the exit code is 2
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; : > $w/tests; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh alpha >/dev/null 2>&1; printf 'rc=%s workbook=%s' "$?" "$([ -e $w/workbooks/alpha ] && echo left || echo gone)"

cases.name: without ORKEON_WORKSHOP nor a project folder, the working directory is the workshop when it holds teams/
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; cd $w && bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh alpha >/dev/null; printf 'rc=%s status=%s' "$?" "$([ -f $w/workbooks/alpha/STATUS.md ] && echo here)"

cases.name: a slug of 63 characters is the longest one
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; a=$(printf 'a%.0s' $(seq 1 63)); bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh $a >/dev/null 2>&1; x=$?; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh ${a}a >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '63=%s 64=%s' "$x" "$?"

cases.name: a file or a link that bears the slug where a folder is expected is the user's: refused, and still there
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; mkdir -p $w/workbooks $w/tests; echo mine > $w/workbooks/afile; echo mine > $w/tests/bfile; ln -s /nowhere $w/workbooks/dlink; for s in afile bfile dlink; do bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh $s >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '%s ' "$?"; done; printf 'afile=%s bfile=%s dlink=%s' "$(cat $w/workbooks/afile)" "$(cat $w/tests/bfile)" "$([ -L $w/workbooks/dlink ] && echo kept || echo gone)"

cases.name: the roll-back removes what the run created and nothing else: an empty workbook folder that was there stays, empty
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams $w/workbooks/alpha; : > $w/tests; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh alpha >/dev/null 2>&1; printf 'rc=%s workbook=%s inside=%s' "$?" "$([ -d $w/workbooks/alpha ] && echo kept || echo gone)" "$(ls -A $w/workbooks/alpha | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

cases.name: a tests folder that was there before a failed run is still there after it
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams $w/tests/alpha; echo keep > $w/tests/alpha/old.txt; : > $w/workbooks; export ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w; bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh alpha >/dev/null 2>&1; printf 'rc=%s tests=%s' "$?" "$(cat $w/tests/alpha/old.txt 2>/dev/null)"

cases.name: ORKEON_WORKSHOP wins over the working directory
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; o={{FIX}}/other-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $w/teams $o/teams; cd $o && ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w bash {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh alpha >/dev/null; printf 'in_workshop=%s in_cwd=%s' "$([ -f $w/workbooks/alpha/STATUS.md ] && echo yes || echo no)" "$([ -e $o/workbooks ] && echo yes || echo no)"

cases.name: a failure after the folders are made removes the files this run wrote and spares what was there: an empty workbook folder stays empty, a tests folder keeps its files
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-{{SID}}; c=$w/.c; mkdir -p $w/teams $w/workbooks/alpha $w/tests/alpha $c/skills/team-init $c/templates && echo keep > $w/tests/alpha/a.json && cp -r {{CLAUDE}}/lib $c/ && cp -r {{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-init/scripts $c/skills/team-init/ && cp {{CLAUDE}}/templates/DECISION.md $c/templates/ && sed 's/^phase: need$/phase: broken/' {{CLAUDE}}/templates/STATUS.md > $c/templates/STATUS.md; ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$w bash $c/skills/team-init/scripts/team-init.sh alpha >/dev/null 2>&1; printf 'rc=%s workbook=%s inside=%s tests=%s' "$?" "$([ -d $w/workbooks/alpha ] && echo kept || echo gone)" "$(ls -A $w/workbooks/alpha 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" "$(cat $w/tests/alpha/a.json 2>/dev/null)"
